record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the first convolution's GELU branch in each NextItNet residual block with a gated linear unit: emit 2H channels, split into a and b, and use a*sigmoid(b) before existing dropout and the second causal convolution. Content-dependent gates may suppress irrelevant history signals. Preserve dilations, residual paths, embeddings, readout, dot-product scores, loss and optimizer. Update the predictor writer for identical architecture and checkpoint loading; retain one model per category.
